content:
The best med spa SEO company is one that already works with aesthetic clinics, builds a page for each treatment, manages your Google Business Profile and reviews, follows medical advertising rules, and reports booked consultations, not just rankings. Below, we compare four options against those points.

Key Takeaways

Most med spa clients compare several clinics before they book, so SEO has to build trust as well as rankings. Good med spa SEO covers four areas: a complete Google Business Profile with real photos and reviews, one page for each treatment such as Botox®, fillers or laser hair removal, content that answers cost and safety questions, and a fast mobile site with online booking. It also has to respect medical advertising rules, including trademarked product names and consent for before-and-after photos. When you compare agencies, check their aesthetic clients, who owns your accounts, contract length and how they track booked consultations. Expect three to six months before treatment pages rank well.

Why Med Spas Need SEO Built for Aesthetic Clinics

Med spa clients research for days before they book an injectable or laser treatment, and most of that research starts on Google. They compare several clinics, read reviews and look for answers on cost and safety. Generic SEO misses treatment searches and medical advertising rules. This post explains what good med spa SEO includes, then compares four med spa SEO companies. Good SEO for aesthetic clinics can:
  • Bring more organic traffic to your website.
  • Turn searches into consultation requests and bookings.
  • Build trust through reviews, provider bios and clear answers.
  • Help you show up in local searches such as "med spa near me".
  • Give you a steady, lower-cost lead source than paid ads alone.
For the full service, see our SEO services.

What Good Med Spa SEO Includes

Good med spa SEO rests on five things, covered below.

Treatment Pages for Botox®, Fillers, Laser and More

Each main treatment needs its own page, because clients search for the treatment, not "med spa". Build one page each for neurotoxins such as Botox®, fillers, laser hair removal, microneedling, chemical peels and body contouring. Each page should cover who the treatment is for, what to expect, recovery time, a price range or "from" price, provider credentials and a booking button. Do not make claims about results or safety. Our med spa marketing work follows the same page structure.

Google Business Profile and Local Rankings

Your Google Business Profile decides whether you show up when someone searches "med spa near me". Fill it out fully and keep it current.
  • Choose a main category that fits, such as "Medical spa".
  • List each treatment as a service.
  • Upload real photos of the clinic and team.
  • Post weekly.
  • Keep your name, address and phone the same everywhere.
  • For multi-location groups, use one profile and one location page per clinic.

Reviews, Before-and-After Photos and Trust

Clients pick a med spa they trust, and reviews and real results build that trust.
  • Ask for a review after treatment and reply to every one.
  • Add provider bios with credentials.
  • Use before-and-after photos only with written patient consent.
  • Never reveal patient details in review replies.
Our review management service can handle requests and replies. This is not legal advice, so check privacy and consent wording with your medical director or lawyer.

Staying Within Medical Advertising Rules

Med spa content has to follow medical advertising rules, so check that your agency knows them. Run every page and post against this list, and check it with your medical director or lawyer.
  • Use trademarked names correctly. Botox® is a registered trademark.
  • Do not promise or guarantee results.
  • Show testimonials that reflect typical experiences, in line with FTC endorsement rules.
  • Get consent before you use before-and-after photos.
  • Rules on who can perform treatments vary by state, so check your state.

Seasonal Content and AI Search Visibility

Demand for some treatments rises at set times each year, so plan pages and posts ahead. Publish 4 to 6 weeks before the peak.

AI answers such as ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews draw on clear treatment pages, consistent listings and reviews. No one can guarantee placement. See our AI SEO service.

How We Ranked These Med Spa SEO Companies

We compared each company on seven points that matter to an aesthetic clinic.
  • Industry specialization: work with med spas and aesthetic clinics.
  • Evidence: named med spa clients or published case studies.
  • Services: technical SEO, content, local SEO and link building.
  • Client testimonials.
  • Ability to keep up with search changes.
  • Pricing transparency.
  • Account ownership and contract terms.

What Med Spa SEO Costs

Most med spas spend between $1,500 and $5,000 per month on SEO. The price moves with the number of treatments and locations, how competitive your market is, and how much content you need. Watch out for long lock-in contracts and unclear deliverables. For a full breakdown, read our med spa SEO cost breakdown.

Questions to Ask Before You Hire a Med Spa SEO Company

Ask these questions before you sign with any med spa SEO company.
  1. Which med spas or aesthetic clinics do you work with now? Med spa SEO differs from general medical SEO.
  2. Who owns my website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts? You should keep all three if you leave.
  3. How long is the contract? Long lock-ins make it hard to switch.
  4. How do you track booked consultations? Rankings alone do not fill your calendar.
  5. How do you handle medical advertising rules? Mistakes with claims and photos can hurt your clinic.
  6. What will you do in the first 90 days? A clear plan shows they know the work.

h1: Best Med Spa SEO Companies for Aesthetic Clinics Compared

faqs.question: What does a med spa SEO company do?
faqs.answer: It helps your clinic show up when people nearby search for your treatments. That covers treatment pages, your Google Business Profile, reviews, site speed and content that answers client questions.

faqs.question: How long does med spa SEO take to work?
faqs.answer: Google Business Profile fixes can show movement within one to two months. Treatment pages usually take three to six months to rank, depending on how many clinics compete in your area.

faqs.question: How much does med spa SEO cost?
faqs.answer: Most med spas spend between $1,500 and $5,000 per month. See our med spa SEO cost breakdown for what drives the price.

faqs.question: Is SEO for med spas different from SEO for plastic surgeons?
faqs.answer: Yes. Med spas sell repeat, non-surgical treatments to nearby clients, so local search and treatment pages matter most. Plastic surgery clients research longer and travel farther for one large procedure.

faqs.question: Do I own my website and Google profile if I leave an agency?
faqs.answer: You should. Ask for ownership of your website, Google Business Profile and ad accounts in writing before you sign.

faqs.question: Can SEO help my med spa show up in ChatGPT or Google AI answers?
faqs.answer: It can help, but no one can guarantee it. Clear treatment pages, consistent listings and strong reviews make your clinic easier for AI tools to find and cite.

faqs.question: Which med spa SEO company is best?
faqs.answer: The best fit depends on your clinic's size and goals. Look for aesthetic experience, account ownership, clear pricing and tracking of booked consultations. Our comparison above ranks four options against those points.
